insights.summary: Success in this niche is driven by high-intent personalization like 'custom vinyl lyrics print' and specific quirky humor such as 'tigers eating pizza' or 'duck wine party'. While generic trends like 'danish pastel' are failing, heritage-based art including 'william morris' and 'japanese woodblock' remains a dominant, high-conversion staple.

winningPatterns.title: Personalized Music & Sentiment
winningPatterns.detail: High-conversion listings focus on specific musical memories and gift-giving occasions like weddings and anniversaries.

winningPatterns.title: Quirky Animal Narrative
winningPatterns.detail: Top sellers feature animals in humorous, human-like scenarios, particularly involving food or drink.

winningPatterns.title: Heritage & Botanical Institutions
winningPatterns.detail: Leveraging established artistic names and famous botanical gardens provides a strong trust signal for decor buyers.

winningPatterns.title: Dopamine & Maximalist Aesthetics
winningPatterns.detail: Vibrant, high-energy styles are outperforming minimalist trends, specifically when targeted at bathrooms or bedrooms.

winningPatterns.title: Traditional Japanese Woodblock
winningPatterns.detail: Specific nature-themed Japanese art styles have high average sales per listing compared to generic nature prints.
examples: japanese crane in swirling cloud skies

titleStructures.why: This structure captures specific long-tail searches (what the animal is doing) while hitting broad room-based keywords.
titleStructures.example: Tiger Drinking Coffee Art Print, Quirky Animal Poster, Retro Kitchen Decor, Funny Maximalist Wall Art

titleStructures.why: High-performing shops use technical size specs like A1/A2 in titles to capture buyers looking for specific frame fits.
titleStructures.example: William Morris Strawberry Thief Print, Botanical Exhibition Poster, London Art Print, A1/A2/A3/A4

titleStructures.why: This targets the highest-selling niche in the data (custom music) by focusing on the gift utility.
titleStructures.example: Custom Song Lyrics Print, Personalised Wedding Anniversary Gift, Vinyl Record Poster, First Dance Sheet Music Art

tagStrategies.detail: Using international paper sizes in tags to capture shoppers with specific frames.
Moving beyond 'living room' to target specific high-intent corners of the home.
Tagging for specific interior design sub-cultures rather than just 'home decor'.
Focusing on the 'why' behind the purchase to capture seasonal and milestone traffic.

gaps.detail: The success of 'human anatomy poster' and 'doctor office decor' suggests a gap for other professional-themed vintage art.
Keywords like 'mughal floral arch' and 'jaipur palace' show high sales potential with very low shop competition.
High sales for 'book lovers gift' and 'reading poster' indicate a strong market for bibliophile-specific wall art.

avoid.why: Listings using 'preppy dog art' and 'danish pastel decor' consistently show the lowest sales (0.01-0.02) in the library.
The top-performing listings almost exclusively use 'Posters' or 'Prints'; 'Canvas' is heavily associated with the lowest-selling items.
